description: Owns medication/supplement definitions and intake logs: creates schedules, records doses taken, and computes adherence.
name: medication-agent

skills.description: Parse free text into a structured medication definition: name (kebab-case), dose (e.g. '200mg'), schedule (free-text e.g. 'daily 21:00' or 'mon,wed,fri morning'), optional notes. Inserts a row in the medications table.
skills.name: Define Medication

skills.description: Record a single dose taken. Accepts {name} (resolved via registry with name normalization) and optional {dose_override, note}.
skills.name: Log Medication Taken

skills.description: Deterministic list of active medications with last-taken recency.
skills.name: List Active Medications

skills.description: Compute adherence window (default 14 days): expected doses from schedule × actual logs from health_logs → percentage + missed days + streak. Aggregations in SQL, final summary via LLM.
examples: did I miss any doses last week
skills.name: Analyze Adherence

skills.description: Soft-delete a medication (set archived_at). History in health_logs is preserved via the denormalized `name` field.
skills.name: Archive Medication
